headline: Market Rebounds on Yen Intervention; AI Chip Demand Drives Hyperscaler Capex
summary: Global markets saw a rebound today, with the Korea Kospi index jumping 18% on record volume. US Treasury intervention supported the yen, reversing recent losses. AI chip demand continues to drive significant capex increases from major hyperscalers, while Capital One closed Trump Organization accounts.

x_themes.topic: Hyperscaler Capex Increase for AI Infrastructure
x_themes.summary: Major hyperscalers (Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft) raised their combined 2026 capex forecast to $720-$745 billion, citing demand for compute exceeding capacity and a bullish outlook for upstream semiconductors and neoclouds.

AIXA reports demand for MOCVD machines outstripping supply, while AXTI sees massive InP substrate revenue growth and LTAs, indicating strong demand for optical components and potential for IQE to provide epitaxy services.

Following recent market liquidations and hedge fund adjustments, a bullish sentiment for AI stocks is emerging, with observations of Citadel closing shorts and going long, Hynix/Samsung clarity, and strong hyperscaler capex guidance.

x_themes.topic: Fed's Warsh Considers Fewer Policy Meetings
x_themes.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is considering reducing the frequency of FOMC policy meetings from the current eight annually, asking officials for feedback on a revised schedule.

x_themes.topic: Alibaba's Investment & Compute Deal with Moonshot AI
x_themes.summary: Alibaba owns 36% of Moonshot AI and has a compute deal to provide 20,000 Nvidia H200 chips for Moonshot AI's Kimi model, highlighting strategic partnerships in the AI model space.

x_themes.topic: ASE Capex Increase for Advanced Packaging
x_themes.summary: ASE, a chip packaging giant, raised its 2026 capex forecast to US$10.5 billion from $8.5 billion due to strong demand for advanced and general packaging, seeing glass substrates and silicon photonics as key to overcoming hardware bottlenecks.

x_themes.topic: AUO FOPLP Glass Substrate Packaging Pilot Line
x_themes.summary: AUO plans to invest NT$8.64 billion (US$267M) in a FOPLP advanced chip packaging pilot line utilizing glass substrates, targeting applications like LEO satellite antennas, Micro LEDs, and optical communications.

x_themes.topic: Apple's Memory Cost Surge & AI Demand
x_themes.summary: Apple CEO Tim Cook described current memory price surge as a “100-year flood,” expecting costs to rise further due to AI data-center demand absorbing HBM and server-memory capacity, tightening supply for conventional DRAM and NAND.

x_themes.topic: iPhone 18 Pro Price Hike Risk from Memory/Foundry Costs
x_themes.summary: Higher costs for 2nm silicon and DRAM/NAND could lead to a $250–300 price hike for the iPhone 18 Pro/PM, creating demand uncertainty despite resilient iPhone 17 builds.

x_themes.topic: Yageo AI Server MLCC Demand & Pricing
x_themes.summary: Yageo, Taiwan's largest passive component maker, reports “very, very strong” demand for AI server components, leading customers to pay premiums and sign LTAs, with Yageo having raised prices in Q2 and potentially again.

x_themes.topic: Delta Electronics 800V DC Equipment Production Ramp
x_themes.summary: Delta Electronics is increasing capex to NT$70 billion this year, with mass production of 800V DC equipment expected to begin in Q3, driven by the continuous wave of AI data center construction.

Microsoft's Copilot progress exceeded expectations, and Azure shows an optimistic outlook, with MSFT accelerating Azure growth while remaining FCF-positive and improving CAPEX ROI by hosting open-source models, giving it strong financing advantages.
Amazon shares surged 15%, marking its best day since 2012, contributing to a collective $1.3T market cap increase for Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, signaling a strong return for hyperscalers.
The Korea Kospi index jumped 18% in one day, its biggest single-day gain on record, signaling a generational bull market in Korea.
